programme_name: Master's degree in Languages, Literatures and Digital Culture
admission_type_official_wording: Subject to entry requirements; public selection for pre-admission for eligible international applicants

admission_routes.notes: 2026/27 call for foreign-degree holders of non-Italian citizenship not already resident in Italy.
Required after pre-admission for visa purposes.

academic_requirements.summary: Bachelor's degree in Humanities/Modern Languages (or eligible foreign qualification), with two studied languages and two related literatures/cultures. Ordinary-route applicants need 18 CFU in each chosen language and 18 CFU in each related literature/culture; applicants still completing a Bachelor's need at least 150 CFU at eligibility-check submission.
academic_requirements.eligible_foreign_qualifications: Foreign qualification recognised as eligible and meeting the curricular preparation.

minimum_credits_by_subject_area.subject_area_or_ssd: Second language and translation: same sectors
First literature/culture: L-LIN/03, /05, /10, /13, /21 or related area subject
minimum_credits_by_subject_area.notes: Russian literature and/or related area subject.

academic_requirements.minimum_grade_or_gpa: 70/100 or higher for the 2026/27 international pre-admission call; no minimum stated on the ordinary programme page.
academic_requirements.curriculum_assessment: International selection evaluates CV/relevance (0-50), CGPA (0-10), and conditional online interview (0-40). Native speakers must show curricular linguistic knowledge of their language.

ranking_and_quota.ranking_details: International-call ranking due by 15 May 2026; one scholarship and up to four non-EU €1,000 flat-rate awards allocated. No general admission cap stated.

selection_components.component: CV and relevance of academic and extra-academic experience

selection_components.weight_or_threshold: 0-40; at least 20 interview points and 60/100 overall
selection_components.notes: Only candidates with at least 36/60 on CV plus CGPA are interviewed.

language_requirements.summary: C1 in both chosen languages. If English is neither chosen language, English B2 is additionally required.
language_requirements.english_level_cefr: C1 if chosen as first/second language; otherwise B2
accepted_language_certificates: Certificates in the UNIVR equivalence list
Duolingo only for candidates from Iran or Afghanistan under the international call
certificate_exemptions: Competence recorded in the degree certificate or Diploma Supplement on the ordinary route
University of Verona Foreign Languages and Literatures graduates need not submit a CLA certificate on the ordinary route
language_requirements.notes: The general international page exempts English-taught Master's students from the Italian test.

required_documents.document: Identity document; passport for non-EU applicants
Bachelor's certificate or enrolment/self-certification with expected completion date

required_documents.condition: Include exams and preferably ECTS, weighted average and grading range.
Evidence for both chosen languages and English where additionally required.

required_documents.document: Self-certification/list of completed exams and SSDs

document_legalisation_translation_rules: Successful international applicants submit official translation and legalisation of the diploma plus Declaration of Value; CIMEA Comparability and Verification statements may replace those respectively.

entry_exam_or_test.name: Online interview
entry_exam_or_test.minimum_score: 20/40 interview and 60/100 overall under international call
entry_exam_or_test.notes: International-call interview only for candidates reaching 36/60 on the first two criteria; ordinary route is curricular and language-document assessment.

application_fee.notes: International pre-admission fee, deducted on enrolment except for scholarship winners.

tuition_amount_basis: First instalment €358; later instalments variable by ISEEU/equivalent ISEE. International differentiated flat rates and call awards may apply.

source_quotes.quote: Duration 2 years ... Degree class LM-37 R ... Administrative headquarters verona ... Language English
Certification of language proficiency corresponding to C1 level ... in BOTH chosen languages

applicant_category_notes: The international call is restricted to foreign-degree holders of non-Italian citizenship not already resident in Italy. Others use the ordinary route.

uncertainty_notes.issue: No general admission-place quota is published in the reviewed sources.

research_completeness.notes: 2026/27 official programme and call sources used.
